title: MACHINE LEARNING AND DATA MINING
description: Introduces machine learning and data mining algorithms and tools that are widely employed in industrial and research settings. Explores supervised learning for prediction problems, both discrete and real-valued; unsupervised learning for clustering data and discovering patterns in data sets; and reinforcement learning for controlling complex processes based on positive and negative feedback. Applies machine learning and data mining techniques to real problems with programming assignments and written homework assignments.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: (CS 325 or 325H) and (ST 314 or ECE 353).
A minimum grade of C is required in CS 325, CS 325H, ST 314 and ECE 353.

Enrollment is limited to students with a program in Computer Science (307).

Enrollment limited to students in the College of Engineering college.
